author: Bobby Grayson
description: Scratch source with @type msg :: {:ping, pid(), mode()} | {:count, non_neg_integer()} and only a handle_cast for :ping produced no crash clause for :count. On the BEAM a cast of :count would crash. Unchanged in this piece because it is orthogonal to the output-shape change; a follow-up could default unclassified msg tags of a GenServer module to handle_cast.
title: Pre-existing gap noticed (not changed): a @type msg tag with no clause in any callback is unclassified by classify/1 and gets no crash clause (e.g. {:count, n} in a scratch test); only tags seen in a clause or in @type call are classified
